lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1}
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] {f : E → ℝ} {X : ℝ → E}
  {z : E} {T : ℝ},
  0 ≤ T →
    ContDiff ℝ 2 f →
      ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f →
        IsMinOn f Set.univ z →
          ContinuousOn X (Set.Icc 0 T) →
            (∀ t ∈ Set.Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt X (-gradient f (X t)) (Set.Ici t) t) →
              AntitoneOn (fun t => t ^ 2 * ‖gradient f (X t)‖ ^ 2 + 2 * t * (f (X t) - f z) + ‖X t - z‖ ^ 2)
                  (Set.Icc 0 T) ∧
                ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc 0 T,
                  ‖gradient f (X t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖X 0 - z‖ ^ 2 / t ^ 2 ∧ f (X t) - f z ≤ ‖X 0 - z‖ ^ 2 / (4 * t)
approved_definition_context: ContDiff R 2 f means twice continuously Frechet differentiable. gradient f x is the Riesz representative of its Frechet derivative in the complete real inner-product space.
ConvexOn R Set.univ f means f((1-a)x+a y)<=(1-a)f(x)+a f(y) for all x,y and a in [0,1]. IsMinOn f Set.univ z means f(z)<=f(x) for all x.

Set.Icc a b is [a,b]; Set.Ico a b is [a,b); Set.Ioc a b is (a,b]; Set.Ici t is [t,infinity). HasDerivWithinAt X v (Set.Ici t) t is the right derivative equal to v. ContinuousOn includes relative continuity at interval endpoints.
AntitoneOn L S means L(b)<=L(a) whenever a,b belong to S and a<=b. Norm and inner-product structures are those of the stated real Hilbert space.
